api_metadata.name: OMD Sandbox API
api_metadata.purpose: Universal mock target server for Apigee API Gateway policies.
api_metadata.routing_mode: Single catch-all wildcard (/*) controlled via the 'omd_mode' query parameter.

/* (Universal Catch-All).description: The only endpoint of the API. Its behavior is dictated by the 'omd_mode' parameter. Any path is accepted.

query_parameters.omd_mode: Defines the core behavior: 'info' (returns documentation), 'echo' (returns request metadata), or 'test' (dynamic mocking). Default: 'test'.
query_parameters.omd_payload: Explicit payload ID or 'body'. Default: undefined.
query_parameters.omd_headers: Boolean ('true' or 'false'). Reflects request headers. Default: false.
query_parameters.omd_convert: Target format to convert the response to ('json', 'xml', or 'soap'). Default: none.

predefined_responses.description: When omd_mode=test, the API selects a payload based on omd_status (Exact Match -> Category Match -> Fallback).

usage_examples.scenario: 1. Retrieve API Documentation and Payload Catalog.
